accounting: Neighbors count as candidate evaluations. Seven original scores and dual original/best certificate validations are reported separately. Preflight rejects the entire batch before candidate evaluation if over cap.
interpretation: Fixed saved witnesses and their original bounding grids only. Equal-score neighbors do not prove a subsequent escape. No finite-domain or unrestricted-plane optimum follows.
move_stream_serialization: ASCII comma-separated rx1,ry1,rx2,ry2,ax1,ay1,ax2,ay2,score plus LF per move, no header. Per-witness SHA256 accumulates every move in enumeration order; regenerate using audit_neighborhood(retain_moves=True).
neighborhood: All C(n,2)*C(width*height-n,2) distinct fixed-witness exact two-exchange neighbors; no symmetry quotient.
order: Occupied and originally vacant coordinates lexicographic; removed pairs itertools.combinations order, then added pairs combinations order; first minimum breaks ties.
outputs: Full per-witness score histogram and better/equal/worse counts
Best-neighbor coordinates and dual exact certificates
question: Does replacing exactly two occupied sites by exactly two originally vacant sites improve or tie any of the seven fixed compact winners?
